content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-60. - Transient merchants.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any transient merchant, as that term is defined in the Land
               Development Code, to engage in any such business within the city without first obtaining
               a permit therefor in compliance with the provisions of the zoning ordinance.
(Code 1981, § 21-30…
